This identifies the different types of events through a consent's lifecycle.
A consent becomes GRANTED after consumer consent with Data Holder
it can be revoked by a consumer via ADR or Data Holder

parameters.description: Constrain the consent event result list with timestamp at or before this date/time. Format is aligned to DateTimeString common type

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: A state is generated by the consent user-agent (browser) and is used to bind the redirection response from a Data Holder with a user session as per https://openid.net/specs/openid-financial-api-part-1-1_0-final.html#public-client. It is sent in the authentication request, and is then also included redirect from the ADH to the ADR. This allows the ADR client application prevent CSRF attacks. Must be unique per authorization request.
